garment.title: Chikai. Beaded dance girdle or belt. Design of white truncated lozenges with central black cross on a black and blue background with white border. Glass beads are strung on twisted vegetable fibres between two lengths of cotton-wrapped cane and reinforced with vertical fibres at intervals; cotton ties extend from both canes, presumably used for fastening. Two loose strings of beads and a bag of black and white beads.

Chikai. Beaded dance girdle or belt. Design of red triangles on a white background. Glass beads are strung on twisted vegetable fibres between two lengths of cotton-wrapped cane with cotton ties extensions knotted together and presumably used for fastening. Strings of beads are tangled and there are many loose strings which have become detached from the cane ends.

instruments.title: Rattle consisting of band of plaited vegetable fibre string with short strings hanging from it along its length. Nutshell hanging from end of each string, with slit cut in bottom to form bell shape.
Rattle - On catalogue card: "Rattle of nut shells attached to plaited fibre band. Worn on leg during dances.".
